name: DJ Gene & Joanne
reviewNotes:
Resident DJs for Club Brumidi socials; no own website or social page found.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Resident DJs for the Brumidi Lodge (Club Brumidi) dance socials since at least 2021. No website, social page, or booking page of their own found; they are only named in the lodge's listings. The lodge page gives a phone number for Joanne for FULL-table reservations at the lodge event; that is an event reservation line, not a DJ booking contact, so it is not recorded. Not the same as NYC host Gene Eagle (gedance.com) or 'DJ Gene' of Events In Demand (no link to Long Island found).
description: DJ team that plays the music at the dance socials at the Brumidi Lodge (Sons of Italy) in Deer Park, mixing ballroom, Latin, tango, West Coast swing and hustle for partner dancers.

evidence.note: Lodge event page: Friday Night Dance Social with DJ Gene & Joanne at 2075 Deer Park Ave, Deer Park; social dance mix of tango, West Coast swing, hustle and more; next dates Oct 10, Nov 6, Dec 18 (2026).
Babylon Beacon (May 2021): Brumidi Lodge's Wednesday Night Dance Social returned with music by DJ Gene and Joanne.
Brumidi Lodge's public Facebook post (Sept 2021) advertises a Latin Social Mix with music by DJ Gene & Joanne.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: sonsofitalyli.com, babylonbeacon.com, facebook.com.
